name: Z2 Pro
summary: The A. O. Smith Z2 Pro is a premium under-counter RO water purifier that keeps your kitchen clutter-free while delivering 100% RO purified, mineral-rich drinking water .
intro: The A. O. Smith Z2 Pro is a premium under-counter RO water purifier designed for modern modular kitchens. Featuring 100% RO purification with Copper Fortified Mineralizer (CFM) and Alkaline Technology, it delivers safe, healthy, mineral-rich drinking water while keeping your countertop clutter-free. With up to 95% TDS reduction, a 15 LPH purification rate, digital display, elegant faucet, and up to 30% water recovery, it is ideal for borewell, tanker, and mixed water sources.
